business_problem: NIO wanted to raise software-engineering speed for smart-cockpit work without giving up code quality or security. The team needed help with repetitive coding, interface lookup, testing, and bug prevention, but it also required enterprise controls around source-code privacy and tailored coding standards.
solution_summary: NIO introduced Alibaba Cloud Qoder CN into its smart-cockpit engineering workflow as a governed AI software-factory layer. Developers use the assistant for code completion, natural-language-to-code generation, interface interpretation, comment generation, and knowledge-backed code templates so they can spend less time on repetitive tasks and uncommon API lookups. The platform also includes a unit-test agent that can generate tests against changed files, compile and run them, and help repair failures, which turns AI into part of the validation path instead of only a code suggester. NIO also uses Qoder CN's knowledge-management and extension-management capabilities to codify naming rules, API-document generation, and historical bug-prevention prompts under enterprise governance. The deployment remains inside a dedicated enterprise environment so source code stays under internal control while the team still gets broad AI assistance across development and maintenance.

solution_components.name: Qoder CN
solution_components.role: Provides the enterprise coding assistant for code generation, explanation, testing, and rule-guided review.

data_flow: Developers invoke Qoder CN inside their daily engineering workflow, where project context, prompts, and enterprise knowledge are used to generate code, comments, tests, and risk warnings. Outputs flow back into the development process and are refined with NIO's extension and knowledge rules before code is committed.
business_outcome: NIO embedded AI directly into engineering rather than running isolated code experiments. The team now uses AI-generated code and tests at meaningful scale, supports faster smart-cockpit delivery, and keeps source-code assistance inside a governed enterprise environment built around quality and security requirements.
metrics: nearly 400 members in the smart-cockpit R&D team use Qoder CN
AI-generated code contributes 30% to 40% of day-to-day development output
incremental AI-generated code in the Tiantan project reached more than 70%

architecture_clues: NIO uses AI not only for code completion but also for unit-test generation and commit-time bug-risk detection.
Enterprise knowledge and custom extensions are used to encode rules, templates, and API documentation practices inside the coding workflow.
The coding assistant is treated as a governed enterprise deployment rather than a generic public model endpoint.
